---
name: Feature
about: Something you need the desk to do that it does not do yet
labels: enhancement
---

**What you are trying to do** (the job, not the implementation)

**What happens today** (the command and what it says, or the setting you looked for)

**Which part it touches** (data, cycle, execution, venues, agents, capital, cli, docs)

**Does it loosen a guarantee?** ([Boundaries](https://docs.bijectivelabs.dev/opensource/boundaries)
lists them; a proposal that does needs to say why the guarantee still holds)
